rules.text: You have 60 days from the date of receiving your item to start a return.
rules.quote: You have 60 days from the date of receiving your item to start a return.

rules.text: Returns are accepted only if items are in pristine condition, unopened, unused and seals intact.
rules.quote: We accept returns for all orders, provided they are in pristine condition. This means they’re unopened, unused and any seals are intact.

rules.text: Exchanges are not offered; customers must place a new order and return the original for a refund.
rules.quote: Please note, we don’t offer exchanges. You will need to place a new order and return your original for a refund.

rules.text: Refunds are processed within 3-5 working days after the return is received.
rules.quote: Once received, we'll refund the amount for the returned goods and send you a notification via email. This can take 3-5 working days from the date we receive the return.

rules.text: Refunds should appear in the customer's account within 5 working days after processing.
rules.quote: Your refund should be returned to your account within 5 working days and we’ll send you an email to let you know it's on its way!
